title: A site's menu leaves out the kit Services page until the Space lists a service
detail: The kit's Services page is the Space's offerings under a short lead, and the offerings block draws nothing when no service is listed, so the page would be a title over blank space. The site menu (automatic and saved-menu catalog) now skips a page with slug `services` that holds an offerings block while the Space lists no public service. The page stays reachable by URL. Any other page, and a Services page the owner wrote without the offerings block, is never hidden.

verify.evidence: site-page.tsx filters the menu through isEmptyServicesPage.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("components/sites/site-page.tsx","utf8");if(!t.includes("isEmptyServicesPage")){console.error("the menu lost its empty Services filter");process.exit(1)}'
